company.name: Deal In City
company.shortDescription: Deal In City is an e-commerce site based in Dubai offering daily deals on fashion, beauty, activities, food and dining, auto, and more.
company.description:
Great Deals | Everyday!
﻿
Deal In City was formed in 2010 by two passionate entrepreneurs from India. DIC is headquartered in Dubai

Deal In City is revolutionizing the way local businesses and consumers come together.   Each and every day, we present our select “Deals Of The Day” from some of the best local businesses including restaurants, museums, spas, fitness centers, attractions, specialty shops and so much more, all at prices that can’t be found anywhere else!
 
Since 2010, our team has been hard at work constantly sourcing local businesses throughout the cities to find the best partners for our daily deals.  And we’re very picky!  We choose to partner only with the businesses that will offer great products and sensational services at prices that make local consumers want spread the word and get out to experience something new.
 
At Deal In City, we believe in the power of social media and word-of-mouth marketing -  so much, in fact, that our business model revolves around it!   We require a minimum number of buyers to activate each Deal Of The Day, and we rely on our subscribers to help us spread the word about our deals to their friends and family.  In turn, our business partners enjoy substantial results that allow them to offer rock-bottom prices. With Deal In City, everyone wins!  Our subscribers get unbelievable deals and our business partners get tremendous volumes of new business they never would have gotten otherwise!
